*Hīnattikādi, Hetuduka* (Patthana 22.23) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon. Like other analytical matrices within the *Paṭṭhāna*, it investigates conditioned relations by cross-combining triad classifications (*tika*, here beginning with the *hīnattika*) and dyad classifications (*duka*, specifically the *hetuduka*) across the conditional system.

Its most significant textual overlap occurs within other divisions of the *Paṭṭhāna*, most prominently *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1; 46 matches), *Hetuduka, Duka* (Patthana 6.1; 18 matches), *Kusalattika, Hetusahetukadukādi* (Patthana 22.4; 10 matches), *Tika Saraṇaduka* (Patthana 4.8; 12 matches), *Kusalattika, Tika* (Patthana 5.1; 11 matches), and *Vitakkattikādi, Hetuduka* (Patthana 22.21; 7 matches) [DharmaNexus].
